name: Scholarship for student communities pursuing higher and Professional Courses (MCAER)
description: This scheme belongs to Muslim, Buddha, Christian, Jain, Sikh, Parsi, Jews religions.

criteria.label: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.
b) Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: c) Candidates should have pass SSC from Maharashtra State.

evidence.quote: c) Candidates should have pass SSC from Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: d) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

evidence.quote: d) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

criteria.label: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) / Institute Level.

evidence.quote: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) / Institute Level.

criteria.label: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

evidence.quote: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.
g) The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.

criteria.label: h) Any two chilldrens from family will be alotted for a scheme.

evidence.quote: h) Any two chilldrens from family will be alotted for a scheme.

criteria.label: Belongs to a minority community (Muslim, Buddhist, Christian, Jain, Sikh, Parsi, Jewish)

evidence.quote: This scheme belongs to Muslim, Buddha, Christian, Jain, Sikh, Parsi, Jews religions.

benefits.text: Total annual course fee is Rs. 50,000, whichever amount is less will be the scholarship amount.

evidence.quote: Total annual course fee is Rs. 50,000, whichever amount is less will be the scholarship amount.

documents.name: a) Educational Certificate – S.S.C.(10th)/ H.S.C(12th).& onwards.

evidence.quote: a) Educational Certificate – S.S.C.(10th)/ H.S.C(12th).& onwards.

documents.name: b) Income certificate of Parents/Form no.16

evidence.quote: b) Income certificate of Parents/Form no.16

documents.name: c) In income certificate/Affidavit it should be clear cut mentioned that candidate belongs to minority community.

evidence.quote: c) In income certificate/Affidavit it should be clear cut mentioned that candidate belongs to minority community.

documents.name: d) Proof of permanent residence: - Copy of Domicile Certificate/Election Card etc.

evidence.quote: d) Proof of permanent residence: - Copy of Domicile Certificate/Election Card etc.

documents.name: e) For Renewal of Scholarship: - Income declaration and Mark Sheet of previous examination.

evidence.quote: e) For Renewal of Scholarship: - Income declaration and Mark Sheet of previous examination.

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
